# Sources

Clearline defines its palette, scales, measures, component dimensions, and
motion values. It has no external identity owner and ships no logo.

| JetBrains Mono | Code | SIL Open Font License 1.1 | <https://www.jetbrains.com/lp/mono/> |

Self-host fonts when a surface must work offline or cannot request third-party
font resources. Keep the applicable license with a self-hosted copy.

The canonical checker calculates the documented semantic text pairs, control
borders, and focus ring/halo boundaries from the token files. Re-run it after
changing a shared color role.
